name: Riot Platforms
industry_role: crypto-mining company pivoting to AI/HPC data center hosting
notes:
Crypto-mining pivot: Q1 2026 was first quarter with real data-center revenue ($33.2M). 20-yr, 191MW lease with a frontier AI lab (reported as Anthropic) worth ~$9.1B; MOU with Terrestrial Energy for nuclear-powered AI/HPC campuses (up to ~4GW). Morgan Stanley provided $573M interim PROJECT FINANCING (debt, Aug 2026) for the Rockdale buildout via subsidiary Riot DC Logistics -- not recorded as an investor edge here since it's project debt, not equity.

M&A: acquired Whinstone US -- ~$651M (closed 26 May 2021, from Northern Data): the Rockdale, TX mega-site. [completed; confidence high; https://www.riotplatforms.com/riot-blockchain-completes-acquisition-of-whinstone-us-creating-leading-north-american-bitcoin-mining-company/]

M&A: acquired Block Mining -- $92.5M + up to $32.5M earn-out (Jul 2024): 60MW in Kentucky; Riot's first non-ERCOT sites. [completed; confidence high; https://www.riotplatforms.com/riot-announces-the-acquisition-of-block-mining-expands-riots-total-potential-power-capacity-to-2-gigawatts/]

M&A: acquired Rhodium Encore -- $185M (closed 28 Apr 2025): Rhodium's assets at Rockdale; ends the hosting dispute and recovers 125MW. [asset purchase (completed); confidence high; https://www.riotplatforms.com/riot-platforms-announces-closing-of-the-acquisition-of-rhodium-assets-at-the-rockdale-facility-following-the-previously-announced-settlement-agreement/]
